heading: Experience that goes beyond training
body:
With more than 20 years of experience working with dogs of all breeds, personalities and behavioural needs, Liza Smith has developed a calm, practical approach that combines professional grooming expertise with an in-depth understanding of canine behaviour.

Years of working hands-on with anxious, reactive and nervous dogs has taught her that behaviour cannot be rushed, forced or ignored. It must be understood.

That's why every recommendation is based on experience, observation and what is right for your individual dog, not a one-size-fits-all solution.
